button.label: Fix Slide Colors

button.label: Open Slide Library
button.supertip: Opens the slide library to search and insert saved slides

button.label: New Slide

button.label: Icon

button.label: Enclose

button.supertip: Sets the text margins to zero and shrinks the selected text boxes and rectangles, or the table columns and rows, to fit their text. The center stays in place. Alt+.

button.label: Bottom

button.label: Arrange shapes

button.label: Stretch shapes to right

button.label: Decrease horizontal gap between shapes
button.supertip: Decreases the horizontal gap between the selected shapes

button.supertip: Resizes and spaces the selected shapes horizontally with equal spacing

button.label: Resize and space vertically (preserve last)

button.label: Add Row
button.supertip: Duplicates the bottom row of the selected grid or table and redistributes every row inside the original height. The outer bounds do not change.

button.label: Del Row
button.supertip: Deletes the bottom row of the selected grid or table and makes the remaining rows fill the original height. The last row is never deleted.

button.label: Bottom TK
button.supertip: Inserts an editable TK placeholder below the selection

button.label: Add Col
button.supertip: Duplicates the rightmost column of the selected grid or table and redistributes every column inside the original width. The outer bounds do not change.

button.label: Del Col
button.supertip: Deletes the rightmost column of the selected grid or table and widens the remaining columns to the original width. The last column is never deleted.

button.label: Right TK
button.supertip: Inserts an editable TK placeholder to the right of the selection

button.label: Add Top TK
button.supertip: Inserts an editable TK placeholder above the selection

button.label: Add Left TK
button.supertip: Inserts an editable TK placeholder to the left of the selection

menu.label: Expand / Shrink
menu.supertip: The older row and column commands that change the outer size of the grid. No keyboard shortcuts.

button.label: Add Right Column — Expand Bounds
button.supertip: Duplicates the rightmost column outside the grid, so the layout gets wider. No keyboard shortcut.

button.label: Add Bottom Row — Expand Bounds
button.supertip: Duplicates the bottom row outside the grid, so the layout gets taller. No keyboard shortcut.

button.label: Delete Right Column — Shrink Bounds
button.supertip: Deletes the rightmost column and leaves the other shapes where they are, so the layout gets narrower. No keyboard shortcut.

button.label: Delete Bottom Row — Shrink Bounds
button.supertip: Deletes the bottom row and leaves the other shapes where they are, so the layout gets shorter. No keyboard shortcut.

button.label: Flip Current Slide
button.supertip: Mirrors the layout of the current slide horizontally. Text stays readable; pictures, icons, and charts are moved but not mirrored. Run again to restore. Ctrl+Z undoes it.

button.label: Flip Entire Presentation
button.supertip: Mirrors the layout of every slide horizontally after saving a backup copy. Text stays readable. Masters, layouts, and notes stay unchanged. Ctrl+Z undoes it.

menu.supertip: Opens the tools for formatting table cells

menu.label: Copy storyline/slide note
menu.supertip: Opens the tools for copying slide notes or storyline content to Word or the clipboard

button.label: Smart Bar
button.supertip: Opens the PPTK command search. Ctrl+K or Ctrl+Space.

button.label: Set same width
button.supertip: Sets all selected objects to the same width

button.label: Set same height
button.supertip: Sets all selected objects to the same height

button.label: Set same height and width
button.supertip: Sets all selected objects to the same height and width

button.label: Match Corner Roundness
button.supertip: Gives the selected rounded rectangles the same visible corner radius as the first one you selected. Sizes, positions, text, and formatting stay. Other shapes are skipped. A then A.

button.label: Unify Shape Type
button.supertip: Changes the other selected shapes to the shape type of the first AutoShape you selected. Each keeps its position, size, text, fill, outline, and rotation. X then T.

button.label: Swap position of two shapes
button.supertip: Swaps the positions of the two selected shapes

menu.supertip: Opens the tools for swapping the positions of two shapes

button.label: Swap position of two shapes (centered)
button.supertip: Swaps the positions of the two selected shapes while centering them

button.label: Swap text
button.supertip: Swaps the text of the two selected shapes

button.label: Size to tallest
button.supertip: Sizes all selected objects to the tallest one

button.label: Size to shortest
button.supertip: Sizes all selected objects to the shortest one

button.label: Size to widest
button.supertip: Sizes all selected objects to the widest one

button.label: Size to narrowest
button.supertip: Sizes all selected objects to the narrowest one
